---
title: "K-LUNG-LIBS: elemental imaging for occupational and environmental exposure"
date: 2026-01-16
description: "A clinical research project using LIBS to investigate carcinogenic metals and exposure signatures in lung tissue."
categories: [Clinical research, Occupational health, LIBS]
---

**K-LUNG-LIBS** investigates whether elemental imaging of lung tissue can reveal signatures associated with occupational and environmental exposure, particularly to carcinogenic metals and particles.

The project illustrates the translational objective of tissue elemental imaging: connecting spatial chemical information with clinically and occupationally relevant questions.
